name: SambaNova SN40L RDU Datasheet & Architecture Specifications
notes: Official SambaNova SN40 RDU datasheet and product specification page (https://sambanova.ai/products/rdu-ai-chips). Specifies TSMC 5nm, Reconfigurable Dataflow Architecture, 640 TFLOPS BF16/FP8 compute, three-tier memory with 520 MB on-chip SRAM, 64 GB HBM2E, and up to 512 GB DDR5.
